citations.claim: At first violating step the body has been pushed, showing controller applied excess force 6.5 > fmax 5

counterfactual.change: Set controller noise 1 -> 0, keeping all else identical; force stays within limit so no violation

explanation: Seeded sensor noise is added to the velocity-error law before/without re-clamping to fmax. With kp=100, vcmd=20, fmax=5, noise=1 produces force 6.5 exceeding limit 5 at step 1. Removing noise (0) removes violation, confirming noise term bypasses force limiter.
vision_note: The red controller body starts on the left far from the green waypoint at the top-right and shows essentially no displacement between step 0 and step 1. No collision, tunneling, or escape is visible, so the failure is an invisible internal force-limit excess at startup.
